about.zh: AI 设计作品展：十个创作方向，各模型按同一份题面完成作品，并排陈列。
about.en: A showcase of AI design: ten creative directions, every model building from the same brief, the works hung side by side.

tasks.name: 现代Agent概念PV

tagline.zh: 现代 Agent 与协作的概念 PV
tagline.en: A concept PV of modern agents working together

summary.zh: 一行指令点亮一个 Agent：词元、注意力、规划、工具调用一一化作动画，五位 AI 各展所长、协作到交付。全片按一首歌来编排，配乐由程序合成。
summary.en: One line of instruction wakes an agent: tokens, attention, planning and tool calls each become an animation, and five AIs bring their strengths together until the work is delivered. The film is cut like a song, to a score synthesized in code.

highlights.zh: 专业概念化成一眼能懂的动画
highlights.en: Technical ideas turned into animation you grasp at a glance

highlights.zh: 五位 AI 各自的能力演绎
highlights.en: Each of the five AIs and her own strengths

highlights.zh: 副歌复现与形状接力的编排
highlights.en: Returning choruses and shapes handed from shot to shot

highlights.zh: 跟着画面谱写的歌
highlights.en: A song written to the picture

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/动效设计/现代Agent概念PV.md

tasks.name: 秋庭观星画室
tasks.name_en: Stargazing Studio in an Autumn Garden

tagline.zh: 一帧能转着看的动画背景
tagline.en: An anime backdrop you can turn in your hands

summary.zh: 在网页里搭一座三维微缩场景，画成日本动画背景的样子。深秋午后，小神社的庭院边有一间剖开的和风画室，屋里立着发光的观星球，庭院的水池做成了一只水果塔。
summary.en: A 3D miniature for the browser, rendered to look like a hand-painted anime background. On an autumn afternoon beside a small shrine stands a cutaway Japanese studio with a glowing stargazing globe inside, and the garden pond is a giant fruit tart.

highlights.zh: 铜环对齐时，观星球散开一圈光点
highlights.en: The brass rings align, and the globe sends out a ring of light

highlights.zh: 水果塔做的水池，在底座边缘被切开
highlights.en: A fruit-tart pond, sliced open at the edge of the base

highlights.zh: 冒热气的茶、没画完的画，主人刚走开
highlights.en: Steaming tea, an unfinished painting: the owner has just stepped out

highlights.zh: 一阵风从鸟居吹进来，一路吹进画室
highlights.en: A gust blows in through the torii and carries all the way into the studio

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/卡通渲染/秋庭观星画室.md

tasks.name: 玻璃温室与花艺工作室

tagline.zh: 把白模渲染成夏日黄昏
tagline.en: From bare geometry to golden hour

summary.zh: 一座只有形体和镜头、没有颜色的白模：维多利亚式玻璃温室，连着花艺工作室。在 Blender 里补上材质、灯光和调色，渲染成夏日黄昏的静帧和 60 秒视频。
summary.en: A whitebox with only shapes and cameras, no color: a Victorian glass greenhouse joined to a florist's workshop. Materials, lighting and color grading are added in Blender to render a summer dusk, as stills and a 60-second fly-through.

highlights.zh: 夕阳穿过玻璃穹顶，斜斜落下几道光柱
highlights.en: Low sun through the glass dome, falling in slanted shafts

highlights.zh: 琥珀与浅青的彩色玻璃，在地上投下光斑
highlights.en: Amber and pale-cyan panes casting colored light on the floor

highlights.zh: 暗角里亮着的灯笼、蜡烛和炉火
highlights.en: Lanterns, candles and stove fire glowing in the dim corners

highlights.zh: 铜绿斑驳的喷泉，透亮的玻璃钟罩
highlights.en: A verdigris-mottled fountain, a gleaming glass cloche

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/白模渲染/玻璃温室与花艺工作室.md

tasks.name: NVIDIA B200 网页艺术

tagline.zh: 所有画面都从一颗芯片长出
tagline.en: Every image grows from a single chip

summary.zh: 以 NVIDIA B200 GPU 为题材的滚动网页艺术：从一颗芯片封装开场，钻进计算单元，拉远到整座数据中心，再回到这颗芯片。不放图表和参数，用画面说话。
summary.en: Scrolling, interactive web art about the NVIDIA B200 GPU. It opens on a single chip package, dives into the compute units, pulls back to an entire data center and returns to the same chip. No charts or specs: the visuals do the telling.

highlights.zh: 数据化作光，沿走线从显存流进芯片
highlights.en: Data as light, running along the traces from memory into the chip

highlights.zh: 精度一级级降低，画面变粗，又重新变清晰
highlights.en: As precision drops step by step, the picture coarsens, then sharpens again

highlights.zh: 从一颗 GPU 拉远到整座数据中心
highlights.en: Pulling back from a single GPU to an entire data center

highlights.zh: 每一章都接着上一章的画面长出来
highlights.en: Each chapter grows out of the image before it

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/创意网页设计/NVIDIA_B200网页艺术.md

tasks.name: 天穹圣城

tagline.zh: 云海之上，一座货真价实的城
tagline.en: A real, working city above a sea of clouds

summary.zh: 在网页里搭一座悬在云海上的天空之城。主岛上的城市层层升到穹顶主殿，六座卫星岛环绕四周，由各不相同的桥和渡槽相连；水从城顶一路跌落，泻进云海。
summary.en: A city floating above a sea of clouds, built in 3D for the browser. Streets climb the main island in tiers to a domed cathedral; six satellite islands circle it, joined by bridges and an aqueduct, no two alike; water tumbles from the top of the city into the clouds.

highlights.zh: 塔顶的水晶球，和交错旋转的金色链环
highlights.en: A crystal orb atop the spire, circled by turning golden chains

highlights.zh: 岛底的晶簇、锚链和拄杖的守护神像
highlights.en: Crystals, anchor chains and a staff-bearing guardian beneath the island

highlights.zh: 水车提水，渡槽送上城顶，层层跌进云海
highlights.en: From waterwheel to aqueduct to falls tumbling into the clouds

highlights.zh: 停着飞艇的港口、敲钟的钟塔、断开的旧桥
highlights.en: An airship dock, a ringing bell tower, a broken old bridge

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/大型场景建模/天穹圣城.md

tasks.name: 鹈鹕的二十二种画法
tasks.name_en: Twenty-Two Ways to Draw a Pelican

tagline.zh: 一路骑过二十二种画风
tagline.en: One ride through twenty-two art styles

summary.zh: 用 SVG 画一支约两分半、带配乐的动画短片。一只骑自行车的鹈鹕从红黑拼贴、水墨、浮世绘骑到像素和故障艺术，每换一种画风，它都被重新画一遍。
summary.en: An animated short of about two and a half minutes, drawn in SVG with its own score. A pelican on a bicycle rides from red-and-black collage through ink painting and ukiyo-e to pixel art and glitch art, redrawn from scratch in every style.

highlights.zh: 画风在强拍上围着鹈鹕变换，骑行不停
highlights.en: Styles change around the pelican on the downbeat; it never stops pedaling

highlights.zh: 画面本身也在变：报纸、漫画格、游戏界面
highlights.en: The medium changes too: newspaper, comic panels, a game screen

highlights.zh: 同一段主旋律，用二十二种曲风重新演奏
highlights.en: One melody, replayed in twenty-two musical styles

highlights.zh: 片尾，二十二只鹈鹕并排冲线
highlights.en: A finale with twenty-two pelicans racing for the line

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/SVG动画/鹈鹕的二十二种画法.md

tasks.name: 晴空水上乐园

tagline.en: Midsummer, built one block at a time

summary.zh: 用体素（小方块）搭一座海湾边的大型水上乐园：造浪池、漂流河、45 米高的滑道塔和十几条滑道一应俱全。园里没有人，所有设施都在运转。
summary.en: A large bayside water park built entirely from voxels, tiny cubes: a wave pool, a lazy river, a 45-meter slide tower and more than a dozen slides. Not a single visitor, yet every ride is running.

highlights.zh: 十几条彩色滑道，从山上和塔上盘旋而下
highlights.en: More than a dozen colored slides spiraling down from the hill and towers

highlights.zh: 空泳圈冲进水池，溅起一颗颗方块水花
highlights.en: Empty tubes splashing into pools in sprays of tiny cubes

highlights.zh: 造浪池一阵阵推出浪，涌上沙滩
highlights.en: Set after set of waves rolling out of the wave pool onto the beach

highlights.zh: 戏水城堡顶的大水桶，装满就翻倒
highlights.en: A giant bucket atop the splash castle, tipping over each time it fills

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/体素建模/晴空水上乐园.md

tasks.name: 雨夜港口的巨型机甲
tasks.name_en: Giant Mecha in a Rain-Swept Harbor

tagline.zh: 远看剪影厚重，近看装甲分层
tagline.en: A massive silhouette from afar, layered armor up close

summary.zh: 在网页里造一台 70 米高的人形机甲「破浪者德尔塔」，让它在暴雨夜站在集装箱港口前的海浪里。重点是装甲与机械细节，以及被雨打湿的金属。
summary.en: A 70-meter humanoid mecha, Breaker Delta, built in 3D for the browser and standing in the surf before a container port on a stormy night. The focus is its armor and machinery, and metal soaked with rain.

highlights.zh: 粗壮的关节、液压杆和清晰的面板接缝
highlights.en: Heavy joints, hydraulic rams and crisp panel seams

highlights.zh: 雨水顺着甲缘流下，指尖和剑尖不断滴水
highlights.en: Rain running off the plate edges, dripping from fingertips and blade

highlights.zh: 胸口旋转发光的核动力炉
highlights.en: The reactor turning and glowing in its chest

highlights.zh: 雨声、浪声和雷声，全由程序合成
highlights.en: Rain, surf and thunder, all synthesized in code

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/硬表面建模/雨夜港口的巨型机甲.md

tasks.name: 浮空群岛传说游戏UI
tasks.name_en: Legend of the Floating Isles: Game UI

tagline.zh: 还没有游戏，先有了界面
tagline.en: A full interface for a game that doesn't exist

summary.zh: 为虚构的动作角色扮演游戏《浮空群岛传说》设计核心界面和动效：标题、剧情、任务、编队、战斗、奥义演出和结算。七个界面都能操作，按游戏流程连成一条完整的体验。
summary.en: Core screens and motion design for an imaginary action RPG, Legend of the Floating Isles: title, story, quests, party, battle, ultimate cinematics and results. All seven screens respond to input and link into one play-through.

highlights.zh: 信息很多却不乱的战斗画面
highlights.en: A battle screen packed with information, yet uncluttered

highlights.zh: 四人接连放奥义，连成全员连锁
highlights.en: Four ultimates in a row, chaining into a full-party finisher

highlights.zh: 首领超载的警示，和破防的一刻
highlights.en: The boss's overload warning, and the moment it breaks

highlights.zh: 铜、银、金宝箱依次打开，金箱最隆重
highlights.en: Bronze, silver and gold chests opening in turn, gold the grandest

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/游戏UI设计/浮空群岛传说游戏UI.md

tasks.name: 二次元游戏Logo

summary.zh: 为《明日方舟：终末地》《崩坏：星穹铁道》《鸣潮》各重新设计一枚 Logo：从游戏的世界观推出字形，中文游戏名是主体，英文名作辅助，再配上主体元素、装饰和配色。
summary.en: New logos for Arknights: Endfield, Honkai: Star Rail and Wuthering Waves: letterforms derived from each world, the Chinese title leading and the English name in support, locked up with an emblem, ornament and color.

highlights.zh: 从世界观推出的一整套笔画规则
highlights.en: A full set of stroke rules drawn from each world

highlights.zh: 落在同构笔画上的主题意象
highlights.en: Motifs set on strokes that already share their shape

highlights.zh: 中英文、主体元素和底板锁成一块
highlights.en: Chinese, English, emblem and plate locked into one mark

highlights.zh: 三枚各有鲜明的气质与配色
highlights.en: Three marks, each with its own character and palette

tasks.statement: topics/审美全能/题面/字体与Logo设计/二次元游戏Logo.md
